en.label: [section] Aim of the course and learning outcomes:
en.content: The course provides a comprehensive orientation in the field of cybercriminal offenses according to the Czech law accompanied by information from EU and international legislation and cross-border cooperation in this area.

en.label: [section] Course content:
en.content: 1.Concept of cybercrime (allowance 2/2) a.Computer systemb.Internet, cyberspacec.Cyber attack2.Legal regulation of cyber crime (allowance 2/1) a.International legislationb.EU legislationc.National legislation3.Scope of law in cyberspace (allowance 4/2) a.Criminal law, Administrative lawb.Presumptions of criminal liabilityc.Civil law – privacy protection, matters in the legal sense, legal proceedings, licenses, compensation for damages4.Personal data protection (allowance 2/1) a.General Data Protection Regulationb.ePrivacy Regulation5.Cyber security legislation (allowance 2/1)6.Liability of information society service providers (ISP) (allowance 2/2) a.Division of providers according to the type of services providedb.Anti-spam regulationc.Marketing on the Internetd.Data retention7.Information cybercrime (allowance 6/2) a.Criminal acts related to infringement of intellectual property rightsb.Crimes committed on publicc.Hacking, cracking, DoS, DDoS attacksd.Criminal activity committed on social networks8.Property cybercrime (allowance 6/2) a.Fraudulent practicesb.Abuse of payment cards9.Investigation and prevention of cybercrime (allowance 2/1) a.Digital footprintb.Electronic evidence

en.label: [section] Assessment methods:
en.content: The student successfully completes the course if he/she obtains at least 60 points from four activities: seminar activity (max. 6 points), presentation (max. 20 points), passing the interim test (max. 24 points), passing the final test (max. 50 points). The final grade is determined by the number of points obtained, namely less than 60 points F, 60 points and more E. 68 points and more D, 75 points and more C, 83 points and more B, 90 points and more A.
